editorial.blurb: De Campana is a beloved Mexican institution where consistency, warmth, and authentically flavored food keep guests coming back for decades.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Enchilada Mexicanas or chicken fajitas—the kitchen's most celebrated dishes—and don't skip the complimentary salsa, which reviewers call the best they've ever had.

topDishes.note: Bold, authentic flavor in every bite
